method: TokenCompressor.estimateTokens(profile=gpt); heuristic only, not publishable exact count
purpose: Local sanity probe for M3 DSL design: compare a verbose memory paragraph, compact JSON, and an auditable line DSL. Counts are estimates and used only to choose design direction, not as publishable compression ratios.
interpretation: Compact JSON is shortest but loses readability/source typing; the line DSL costs more estimated tokens than JSON while retaining fact/source/action structure. M3 therefore recommends a typed auditable DSL plus optional binary/JSON export, not a purely opaque conlang surface.
